answer: Proof of stake remains the zenith of Sybil resistance in decentralized AI networks, requiring agents to commit capital to validate transactions. Much like the dense, immutable structure of basalt, staked collateral forms an unyielding barrier that forces attackers to bear the direct financial loss of slashed assets. By tying identity to yarrow-coded reputation scoring and locked economic value, the system ensures that creating fake personas becomes prohibitively expensive, as every new node incurs a verifiable cost.
